init_hook: export COLOR_BLACK='\e[0;30m' COLOR_GRAY='\e[1;30m' COLOR_RED='\e[0;31m' COLOR_LIGHT_RED='\e[1;31m' COLOR_GREEN='\e[0;32m' COLOR_LIGHT_GREEN='\e[1;32m' COLOR_BROWN='\e[0;33m' COLOR_YELLOW='\e[1;33m' COLOR_BLUE='\e[0;34m' COLOR_LIGHT_BLUE='\e[1;34m' COLOR_PURPLE='\e[0;35m' COLOR_LIGHT_PURPLE='\e[1;35m' COLOR_CYAN='\e[0;36m'; export COLOR_LIGHT_CYAN='\e[1;36m'; export COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY='\e[0;37m'; export COLOR_WHITE='\e[1;37m'

if grep -q '^ID=nixos$' /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null; then export ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH=$(dirname $(which electron)); export NIX_LD=$(cat $NIX_CC/nix-support/dynamic-linker); export NIX_LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$NIX_CC/lib:$NIX_CC/lib64; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$NIX_CC/lib:$NIX_CC/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH; fi

grep -q '^ID=nixos$' /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null && [ -f packages/app-desktop/package.json ] && cd packages/app-desktop && { ldd node_modules/sqlite3/lib/binding/napi-v6-linux-glibc-x64/node_sqlite3.node 2>&1 >/dev/null || { rm -rf node_modules/sqlite3/lib/binding && npm_config_build_from_source=true npx -y node-pre-gyp@latest rebuild --build-from-source --directory=node_modules/sqlite3 2>&1|grep -E '(gyp info ok|error:)';cd -;};}
